title: The geometry of Stein's method of moments: A canonical decomposition via score matching
summary: In this paper, we elucidate the geometry of Stein's method of moments (SMoM). SMoM is a parameter estimation method based on the Stein operator, and yields a wide class of estimators that do not depend on the normalizing constant. We present a canonical decomposition of an SMoM estimator after centering the score matching estimator, which sheds light on the central role of the score matching within the SMoM framework.
